title.zh: 在帕拉尼亚克市Sto. Niño描笼涯设立国立中学，名称为Sto. Nino国立中学，并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Sto. Niño, Parañaque City to Be Known as Sto. Nino National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Establishing a National High School in Barangay Sto. Niño, Parañaque City to Be Known as Sto. Nino National High School and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia tại Barangay Sto. Niño, Parañaque City được biết đến với tên gọi Trường trung học phổ thông quốc gia Sto. Nino
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติในบารังไกย์ Sto. Niño, Parañaque City ให้เป็นที่รู้จักในชื่อโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษาตอนปลายแห่งชาติ Sto. Nino
title.id: Undang-Undang mendirikan Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional di Barangay Sto. Niño, Parañaque City dikenal sebagai Sekolah Menengah Atas Nasional Sto. Nino
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan di Barangay Sto. Niño, Parañaque City dikenali sebagai Sekolah Menengah Kebangsaan Sto. Nino

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2016/ra_10852_2016.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There is hereby established, under the supervision of the Department of Education, a national high school in Barangay Sto. Niño, Parañaque City to be known as Sto. Niño National High School.

The Secretary of Education shall immediately include in the Department’s program the operationalization of the Sto. Niño National High School, the funding of which shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
The Secretary of Education shall issue rules and regulations necessary to carry out the purpose of this Act.
This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
